summary: Iteration 5 — frontend-only retest of the P0 'inline editable Objectif in CA par commercial' fix on /ventes (fresh Playwright run against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, hard reload first). THE FIX NOW WORKS. All 8 objectif cells (Kilian, Theo, Nolan, Kelian, Anaïs, Guillaume, Lucelia, Thomas) render as ENABLED buttons with a Pencil svg for the admin (disabled=False, svgs=1). Clicking objectif-cell-Kilian revealed objectif-input-Kilian + objectif-save-Kilian; filled 15000, clicked save -> toast 'Objectif de Kilian mis à jour' -> row shows 15 000 € and progression recomputed (CA 18 000 € / 15 000 = capped 100%). PERSISTENCE: hard reload of /ventes still shows 15 000 € / 100%. CROSS-TAB: Utilisateurs > Commerciaux shows 'Objectif : 15 000 €' for Kilian (screenshot-verified; the string check only failed because of the U+202F narrow no-break space). REGRESSION: top gauge (objectif-gauge) still reads GET /api/settings.objectif_ca (28% of 150 000 €, went to 31% after adding a 5 000 € sale); '+ Nouvelle vente' flow creates the sale and updates the commercial row instantly (Guillaume 0 €/0 -> 5 000 €/1 and 0% -> 50% with objectif 10 000). Escape/Enter handlers work (Enter saved). No pageerror, no failed /api call except two pre-auth 401 GET /api/settings on the login screen. All test data restored (Kilian and Guillaume objectif back to 0, TEST_QA_ITER5 sale + client deleted, DELETE 200/200).
